contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP ANTONINVS PIVS AVG ; R/ VICTORIA AVG

Silver coin. Denarius of Elagabulus (218-222), mint of Rome issue of 220-221, cf. Sear volume 2 no. 7554, citing RIC vol. no. 160. Obverse description: Bust laureate draped right. Obverse inscription: IMP ANTONINVS PIVS AVG. Reverse description: Victory advancing left with ?palm held horizontally in left hand, star in left field. Reverse inscription: VICTORIA AVG. Diameter: 19.8mm, Weight: 2.33gms, die axis: 12
